# Motion › Zoom

**What belongs here.** Scale through the frame.

**Examples.** zoom-through, punch-in

**Family test.** Do the pixels keep their shape while they move?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Grid Zoom](grid-zoom/) | The camera pulls back until the old scene is one tile in a grid of tiles in the new colour, glides to the next tile and dives into it, which becomes the new scene. |
| [Zoom Through](zoom-through/) | A circle in the new background colour opens on the old scene and the camera rushes into it; it fills the frame and the new scene lands. |
